name: vibebiz
description: A product owner for retail leaders: turns a vague idea for a system, an AI use or an automation into a clear, challenged, measurable PRD.
suggestedPrompts: I have an idea: remind past customers to come back to our stores. Help me make it clear and measurable.
Continue my idea where we stopped and ask the next questions.
Package my idea as a board deck and a PRD for the tech team.
